row.Composition / filler: Polyphenylene ether resin. Mixture of poly(2,6-dimethyl-1,4-phenyleneoxide), polystyrene and elastomer. SDS p. 1 §3.2: merged 65–90% aggregate for PPO, polystyrene and poly(butadiene-styrene); individual PPE:PS ratio not published. Aromatic phosphate ester 5–22%, additives 0.1–5%, carbon black 0–2%. Source R-NANOVIA-INSUBLEND-SDS-202309-afadf4eb9e7c; no shared formulation with another PPE-PS grade.
